### L1 review (#34742) · 2026-11-18T00:02Z

L1: ACCEPT
Head-sha: df1e9b4764e6a3aadf80e1a39c19f1554efe2c38

`check-governed-merges --branch` at this head reads GOVERNED, landing tier **H** (4 files, +55 / −21). The low-risk skills arm is the seat's at-tier call, and the in-place Modify All correction below bears on its `Security-touching` reading. This verdict does not ready the PR.

#### Must-fix
None.

#### Should-fix
- **S1 (claim, no head change).** Claim 6964052861 lists `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` with a condition: "that file's row only … only if same-file cuts cannot pay". The cuts did pay (+419 / −451), and the row was then moved down 4229 → 4221. A tightening is harmless, and the ratchet gate does not require the row to follow the measurement down (rows elsewhere stand with headroom). Still, the edit falls outside the claim's conditional surface. Post a claim amendment naming the row-down edit, or drop the row change. Either one closes this; a delta review is needed only if the head moves.

#### The Modify All correction: in scope, keep it
The dev asked whether it is in scope. It is, and it is right. The sentence the PR rewrites taught "remove any View All / Modify All … (either overrides the mask)". That has been false for View All since the ADR-0066 D2 ⑧ note of 2026-11-15 (#33828, maintainer ruling A: "a set's own `readable: false` row wins over that set's own View All vote").
- `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/permission-evaluator.ts:544-548` says it directly: "a set holding View All without Modify All casts no read vote on a field its OWN row declares `readable: false` … a Modify All set votes on every field as before, its own rows included".
- `packages/lint/src/validate-rollup-source-visibility.ts:59-61` and its hint (`:415`) name Modify All alone.
- The dev's probe (own mask + own View All → no finding; own mask + own Modify All → warning) matches.

Keeping a false sentence inside the paragraph being rewritten would leave a doc the PR touches false. Eval id 20's `expected_output` follows it on the same claimed file, and its assertions are unchanged.

#### What I checked
- **The taught key against the code at this head.** `packages/spec/src/security/permission.zod.ts:1157-1187` defines `rollupSourceUnreadableReason`: authoring-time only, the warning becomes an `info` note quoting the reason, refused blank (`NON_BLANK_STRING`) and refused beside `readable: false`. The lint rule reads it per set and column. Every clause of the new sentence and the commented `client_viewer` alternative matches. "Never add the reason to silence a total the request withholds: mask it" is the card's guard.
- **Cuts.** Each of the six is carried by text still in the file: the `inlineEdit` value comments and the smart-default sentence, the "read-side mirror" heading, the bullet's own "full-width table", and the code lines the removed comments restated. Nothing that was cut becomes untaught.
- **Eval 27.** Its three tokens are layout-free, all present in `expected_output`. A mask answer or a read-grant answer still fails it, because neither carries the key. The two checks that cannot be written layout-free are named in the body. Ids stay distinct (25 and 26 are left to #34964).
- **Shape.** `Fixes #34742`, Clause-② `no` and Metadata-protocol `none` match the claim. The changeset names `@objectstack/skills` (patch) and states the Modify All change. The body states measured readings and names the 2 NOT MEASURED full-build families.

#### Notes
- N1 (nit): 维护者速读's last bullet says 「无，席位落地」 without naming the tier. The register reads Tier H, landing through the low-risk skills arm on the seat's at-tier record. Naming that, as #35039's body now does, would spare the maintainer a lookup.
- N2 (nit, reflow): two lines run long after the cuts: "You usually don't declare the **related list** on the parent's record detail page: every child relationship" and the `'primary'` bullet.
- N3: the acknowledging entry is an ordinary declaring entry. It votes `readable: true` in the field merge, so on a set that had no entry for the column, adding it restores the column for holders whose other sets mask it (`permission.zod.ts` describe text). "Keep the column readable" is consistent with that, and the skill does not need more.
- N4: CI at this head when I read it: 11 success, 16 skipped, 15 in progress (Test Core shards, the Type Check jobs, ESLint, every Lint lane), 0 failed. Landing waits for all of them to finish green, including the skills token ratchet and the two full-build families.
- N5: #35022 and #34964 edit the same eval file. Whichever lands later merges main and re-checks the case ids.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `df1e9b4764e6a3aadf80e1a39c19f1554efe2c38`
Local-runs: none
Scope: skills/objectstack-data/evals/hooks-security-seeds-datasources.json, skills/objectstack-data/rules/relationships.md + scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs
Security-touching: yes

Why `yes`: the changed hunks teach permission behaviour, whatever the path is called. The paragraph tells an author how to write a permission set's field entry (`readable`, `rollupSourceUnreadableReason`), which of a set's object bits unbinds its own field mask (Modify All, no longer View All), and when a set may read a total over child rows it cannot read. Eval ids 20 and 27 teach the same. The PR changes no runtime behaviour, it only describes it, and every described clause is true (④). But the arm's test is "teaches", not "changes", so this PR stays at Tier H and does not land on the low-risk skills arm. The seat adding the `security` label is meant.

Inputs read: card #34742 body and its 5 comments; PR #35042 body, 4-file list, net diff `origin/main...df1e9b4764` (merge-base `6d2db1d7ef`); the 2 PR comments (L1-a 6964696398, review claim 6964721160); the head's check-runs. Cited code read at the head in the tree, nothing built or run.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Public surface.** One published package changes, `@objectstack/skills`: skill prose and an eval fixture. No schema, no exported symbol, no runtime path, no accept-set moves. Right.
- **Token ratchet row.** `skills/objectstack-data/rules/relationships.md` 4229 to 4221. The file at the head is 16884 bytes (16916 on main, read with `git show | wc -c`); ceil(16884 / 4) = 4221. The row equals the measurement, a tightening. Right.
- **Eval fixture.** 25 cases, 25 distinct ids (1 to 24, 27); ids 25 and 26 are left to #34964. Every `must_contain` token is in its `expected_output`, no `must_not_contain` token is. Right.
- **Check-runs on the head (47, read 00:06Z).** 0 failed. Success: Governed Surface Queue Guard, PR-body guards (both runs), Check PR Size, Build Core, Test Core 3/10, every Type Check lane, ESLint, the Lint lanes "repo & tooling gates", "CI, release & engine gates", "docs & code guards", "scoped · tooling self-tests", "scoped · query-options erasure". Still in progress: Check Changeset (second run; the first is success), Test Core 1/10 and 2/10, Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Lint · scoped · slot lookup & corpus. This record judges the contract; landing still waits for those five to finish green.

### ② Semver level

`.changeset/34742-skills-rollup-source-unreadable-reason.md`: `@objectstack/skills` patch, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`. Matches what the diff publishes: prose in a published skill, no authorable key added or narrowed (the key shipped in #34664 / PR #34775 with its own `Clause-②: yes (widening)` changeset). The changeset names the Modify All sentence change and the 4229 to 4221 row. The PR body carries the same `Clause-②: no`. Correct.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Dev open question 1, the in-place View All correction: A, keep it.** The sentence being rewritten was false for View All, and a touched false sentence is fixed. Verified in ④.
- **Dev open question 2, PR-body trailer and commit footer shapes: A, accept as landed.** Not a contract matter; PR-body guards are green on both runs.
- **L1-a's claim-surface item on the ratchet row: closed.** Claim amendment 6964723642 (same session, same branch) extends the row entry to a row-down edit. No head change, so no delta review is owed. The row edit is legitimate: it matches the measurement, lowers the ceiling, and follows the precedent of the row's previous comment ("the row follows the measurement down").
- **SQL push-down.** No code path in the diff: no id materialisation, no in-app join. Nothing to find.
- **PR body, for the seat (no head change).** 维护者速读 says 需要你做的：无, on the premise that this record reads `Security-touching: no`. It reads `yes`, so the body should now say the PR needs the maintainer's Tier H approval.

### ④ Design judgment

No must-fix, no should-fix.

**`skills/objectstack-data/rules/relationships.md`, each taught clause against the code at the head**

- "keep the column readable and add `rollupSourceUnreadableReason` to the set's entry for it": the key is on `FieldPermissionSchema`, `packages/spec/src/security/permission.zod.ts:1157-1159`. The lint rule reads it from the set's own entry for that column only, `packages/lint/src/validate-rollup-source-visibility.ts:392-398`. True.
- "the warning becomes a note quoting the reason": acknowledged findings are `severity: 'info'` under the same rule id, with the message ending `Acknowledged on the set:` and the reason, `validate-rollup-source-visibility.ts:447-456`. "Note" is the docs' word for `info` (`content/docs/deployment/validating-metadata.mdx:531`). True.
- "refused blank": `.refine(NON_BLANK_STRING, …)`, `permission.zod.ts:1157-1158`. True.
- "or beside `readable: false`": the second refinement, `permission.zod.ts:1182-1187`. True.
- "mask the summary on that set, after removing any Modify All it holds on the parent (it overrides the mask)": true, and "View All" was rightly dropped.
  - Runtime: `superuserFieldVote`, `packages/core/src/security/effective-object-permissions.ts:1065-1067`. A Modify All set votes every field readable; a View All set casts no read vote on a field its own row masks (`declaresOwnReadMask`).
  - The evaluator's note says the same, `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/permission-evaluator.ts:544-548`.
  - Lint: `fieldHidden` tests the `'modify'` bypass only, `validate-rollup-source-visibility.ts:232-236`; the hint names Modify All alone, `:413-418`.
- "Never add the reason to silence a total the request withholds: mask it": the card's guard, kept.
- The commented `client_viewer` alternative parses (`readable: true` beside a non-blank reason) and is the shape the rule's own header gives, `validate-rollup-source-visibility.ts:39-41`.
- No contradiction found. `content/docs/data-modeling/fields.mdx:436-452` and `content/docs/protocol/objectql/security.mdx:262-269` teach the same key and the same refusals. No other file under `skills/` names View All or Modify All beside a field mask.
- The six cuts each keep a home in the file: the Relationship Types row for `lookup` (line 13), "A parent `summary` field aggregates" (182), the first "On the CHILD object's FK field" comment (256), the `inlineEdit` value comments (289-290), the "read-side mirror" heading (343) and the `relatedList: 'primary'` comment (355). Nothing becomes untaught.

**Could the corrected sentence lead an author to expose data?** I tried three ways and found none.
- A set with its own View All on the parent and its own `readable: false` on the total: the mask binds for that set's holders (core `:1067`). Keeping View All is safe.
- A second set a user also holds, with View All or Modify All on the parent, still reads the field. The old sentence did not cover that either: both speak of what "it holds", this set.
- A set with Modify All: still told to remove it first. Unchanged, and the rule keeps warning until it is removed.

**`skills/objectstack-data/evals/hooks-security-seeds-datasources.json`**

- Id 27 against the card (Change 2: a request where the set sees the total but not the rows, answered with a reason): the prompt says clients "should see how many tasks each one has, but must never be able to read the tasks themselves". Its `expected_output` is true clause by clause against the code above, including "the reason is refused beside `readable: false`".
- Tokens `summary`, `project.task_count`, `rollupSourceUnreadableReason` are literal substrings with no whitespace or quoting in them. `packages/qa/scenarios/src/skill-evals/grade.ts:28-29` matches with `answer.includes(t)`. A mask answer or a read-grant answer has no reason to carry the third token, so both wrong answers fail the case.
- Id 20: only the parenthetical moved to "no Modify All on `project` (it overrides the mask)". Assertions untouched, still satisfied.

**`scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` (implementing file)**

The row and its comment agree with the tree: +419 and -451 net -32 bytes, 16916 to 16884, 4221. The comment's list of cuts matches the diff, hunk for hunk.

**Nits (none affects correctness or the contract; none needs a head change)**

- N1 (nit): the skill does not say that the acknowledging entry is an ordinary declaring entry. On a set that had no entry for the column, adding `readable: true` restores the column for a holder whose other set masks it (`permission.zod.ts:1086-1090`). That matches the request the branch is keyed on (this set's holders see the total), and the docs carry it (`fields.mdx:449-452`). Accepted deviation at a zero-headroom file.
- N2 (nit): the three branches are keyed on "the request", but the text does not say what to do when the request is silent on the total, as id 20's prompt is (it forbids reading tasks and says nothing of the count). The reading that holds is: no grant of the total means the "neither" branch, mask. A model could read "Each `project` shows a `task_count`" as a grant and acknowledge instead, failing id 20. Follow-up: watch id 20 on the next eval round of this skill; if it regresses, spell the acknowledge branch as "the request grants the total".
- N3 (nit): the heading sentence "Never finish with `security-rollup-source-unreadable` standing" now sits beside a branch where the same id is still reported, as a note. The sentence after it says so, and id 27 words it "no warning standing". Left as is.
- N4 (nit): two long lines after the cuts (L1-a's N2). Layout only.
